styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a bollard-style exit sign with a cylindrical post, a white cap and a number plate showing '3'. The piece is thin and small, so it is slightly sparser than the richest references, but it is cleanly shaded and sits comfortably beside the shipped modern_city props without looking flatter than the bus shelter.
